question: Lavani is a traditional dance of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lavani **is a famous **folk dance **form of Maharashtra State. 
 
• Lavani is a combination of traditional song and dance, which is particularly performed to the **beats of the Dholki, a percussion instrument**.
 
• Lavani is noted for its **powerful rhythm**.
 
• Lavani has contributed substantially to the development of **Marathi folk theatre.**
 
• In Maharashtra and southern Madhya Pradesh, it is performed by female performers wearing **nine-yard-long sarees**.
 
• The lavani dance originated in Maharashtra in the **18th and 19th centuries.**
 
• Lavani dance was generally performed by **Dhangars or Shepherd living in Solapur**, Maharashtra
 
• The songs in 'Lavani' are mostly erotic in sentiment and the dialogues tend to be pungent in socio-political satire.
 
• Originally, it was used as a form of entertainment and morale booster to the tired soldiers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Others traditional folk dances of Maharashtra State -
 
 
• Nakata, Koli, Lezim, Dahikala Dasavtar or Bohada, Tamasha, Mauni, Powara, Gouricha
